DIAGNOSIS READY: Asthma (Post-viral/reactive airway disease).

The normal inflammatory markers and lack of eosinophilia or tryptase elevation make a primary autoimmune or allergic etiology unlikely. The clinical picture of episodic cough and dyspnea triggered by exertion and nighttime, following a viral illness, is most consistent with reactive airway disease.
